listing.name: Bayonetta 2 (B2recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: B2recomp-builder ZIP compiles native game locally from own plainExeFS/RomFSv1.2; no encryptedpackage decryption/keys. Upstream builder owns toolchain/generation. Linuxbuilder testing, not a uniform ready-made runtime. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream describes local Switch recompilation with exact v1.2 input gate. Linux/older-GPU limits remain; completeness is an upstream claim only. Windows builder ZIP, not ready-made runtime; compiles AArch64 code locally with reimplemented NVN Vulkan layer. Preserve full-game maturity limitations from primary documentation. Upstream platforms: Windows 10/11 x64 Vulkan 1.3 builder; Linux builder testing. Polaris Windows workaround adds shader hitches. Original data: Own Bayonetta2 Switch v1.2(updatev131072), extracted plain ExeFS+RomFS. Encrypted NSP/XCI/NCA and keys are refused; project decrypts nothing. Local builder compiles on player machine. Other revisions/regions unsupported unless separately checked; no original BIOS input specified. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
